nodes.label: Transactions Without-Asset Filter NaN URL Loop
nodes.description: Resolved: selecting the null-asset Transactions filter froze the page; DataTable __null__ sentinel passed through Number() produced NaN; strict NaN !== NaN inequality made every reactive pass appear as a new filter change, restarting URL/navigation synchronization indefinitely.

nodes.label: NaN from __null__ Sentinel Numeric Conversion
nodes.description: Root cause: DataTable __null__ sentinel passed to Number() produces NaN; no-op guard using strict equality always returns true for NaN (NaN !== NaN), causing every reactive pass to appear as a new filter change and restart URL navigation.

nodes.label: Explicit without_asset Boolean Filter State
nodes.description: Solution: null selection modelled as without_asset: boolean in filter state and URL; numeric asset_id/asset_ids hold only real IDs; mixed null-plus-ID selections preserve both fields; identical DataTable emissions return null instead of navigating.

nodes.label: Reactive Filter NaN Equality Guard Anti-Pattern
nodes.description: Prevention: normalize null sentinels before numeric conversion; keep semantic null state separate from numeric identifiers; require URL/filter round-trip and repeated-no-op regression tests for reactive filters; never rely on ordinary equality guards for values that may become NaN.
